freePlan.limits: 1 user, 2 invoices/month, 1 bank connection, income/expense tracking and basic profit/loss reporting

keyLimits.en: 1 user plus 2 accountant seats, general business reports
3 users plus 2 accountant seats, enhanced reports, employee time tracking
5 users plus 2 accountant seats, up to 40 classes/locations, inventory tracking
25 users plus 3 accountant seats, unlimited classes/locations, batch tools

cautions.en: Introductory prices (e.g. 50% off for 3 months) are promotional; the figures above are the regular list prices.
The Free plan caps invoicing at 2 per month, which is too low for most active freelance billing.

capabilities.en: Core small-business accounting: income/expense tracking, invoicing, and profit and loss reporting.
AI-assisted features (Intuit Intelligence) for automated expense categorization and tax deduction suggestions.
Mobile app access and accountant/bookkeeper collaboration on paid plans.
Inventory tracking and multi-class/location reporting on higher-tier plans.

limitations.en: The Free plan restricts invoicing to 2 per month and has no mobile app access, limiting it to very light bookkeeping.
Some AI features are explicitly marked BETA or noted as having limited capacity.

reason.en: Direct competitor in small-business cloud accounting software.
Alternative accounting and invoicing tool aimed at freelancers and small businesses.

unknowns: Whether taxes are included in the listed monthly prices was not stated on the pricing page.
